source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: All Soul Tempering Materials & Where to Find Them
source_excerpt:
Weapons in Phantom Blade Zero can be upgraded to make them more powerful. However, there is another way to enhance them even further and unlock new techniques for all Phantom Edges and weapons: Soul Tempering. After reaching Myst's Tavern in Pangzhen, players can talk to Myst, who introduces them to the process.
Soul Tempering requires special materials found throughout the game. Some can be acquired by defeating bosses or completing side quests, while others can simply be found scattered around the world.
Spoilers ahead, including late-game and ending bosses.
All Soul Tempering Materials in Phantom Blade Zero
Defeat The Puppet Scavenger & Acolyte Hansui at the Crimson Manor .
Use Tiger Cannon to access a chest inside a hut.
Use Tiger Cannon to access a chest underground.
Defeat Yucong, No. 34, Twisted Puppet.
Inside a chest at Sha-Chi Tower, which unlocks after entering Mirage Estate. Take the right path from the Crimson Forest Sha-Chi Tower Gate Bell.
Given to you by Mu Xiaokui at the top of Sha-Chi Tower.
Given to you by Jade Dancer after sparring with her at the top of Sha-Chi Tower.
Defeat Jade Dancer, Young Mistress's Guardian & Iron Fiend, Young Mistress's Guardian.
Use Tiger Cannon to access the chest containing this material.
Use Bashpole near Young Master Lan's Hideout Bell.
Obtain it from Child of Insight during the Four Fierce Axes quest.
Defeat Gu Wanyue, the Wailing Wraith.
Check the furnace east of Green Serpent House Bell. You will need to go through the back area near the ladder that takes you through the cave.
Complete the Sword and the Way quest.
Use You Loong's Deluge inside Lion Dance Hall.
Purchase it from Quick Hand Zhang or the Store at a Bell.
Use Illusory Pipa at the building near the Marketplace and open the chest upstairs.
Inside one of the rooms upstairs in Serpent Green House.
Found near the Corpse-Eating Xue boss arena.
Use Flying Guillotine near Behind the Encampment Waterfall Bell.
Find all the Memory Flowers dropped by the NPCs who help you and later turn into enemies. Interact with the flowers using the Story Item obtained during the Shattered Hero's Courage Tale.
Defeat Yan Qaansui, the Zither Maiden.
Defeat the Gold-Masked One at the eastern Long Pillar .
Defeat You Loong, the Frenzied Blackwater Crew Leader.
Use Illusory Pipa at Meigu Village East Dock.
Go west of Meigu Lake, just above Sha-Chi Tower, to find cliffs with a passage between them. Keep sailing the boat through this passage to find the material at the end.
Use Illusory Pipa at Meigu Songhouse Dock.
Find Scorching Flames and the Quenched Flaming Grip.
Interact with the flower next to Old Man Gen, northwest of the region, after completing his quest.
From the Village of Lu Shallows Dock Bell, go southeast to find a wall you can destroy with Tiger Cannon. The material is inside.
Talk to the Lucid Wulin Fighter after defeating Bi Feng.
Use Flying Guillotine near Lady's Path Bell.
Use Flying Guillotine near Cavern Passage Bell.
Found after sliding down multiple times.
Found after fighting an enemy on a roof near the broken ship.
Keep following the snowy path until you reach a hut with this material inside.
Gather Boy's Shoes, Boy's Cap, Boy's Trousers, and Boy's Shirt.
Complete Phantom Illusionist Ruins, then talk to Inanis.
Phantom Illusionist Ruins, Crimson Forest
Talk to Quick Hand Zhang at his hideout .
Found at the Opera House after completing all the storyteller sections.
Defeat the group of enemies during the main story section after Willow Pavilion Bell. They are connected by a purple tether.
Defeat the enemies after Leng Tu's Study Bell. The material is in this area.
Defeat Mo Yuan, Leader of the Bastion of Mo.
Inside a chest next to the Mountain God Temple Bell.
Complete the Severed Mindseal quest.
Defeat Meng Hua, the Merciful Lady of the Blossom Veil.
